# Signal

(己, p=1) The isolated Rheos repair is locally qualified against base `3bc5df2d591a6976a627fe20c806310ebfaf92da`. It remains an uncommitted candidate, with no canonical checkout edits, board operations, commits, pushes, or PR mutations performed by this subtask.

(己, p=1) Pure source framing, section handling, update admission and range patching now live in `shape/content_parser.cljc`; pure task-edit plans consume decoded frontmatter in `domain/task_edit.cljc` and reuse `checked-updates` to admit keys/values at their own public boundary. YAML AST/native conversion remains at the extern edge. `infra/content_parser.cljs` composes and validates YAML before and after patching; infra task editing judges the resulting title before watcher registration, writes and event emission. Existing CLI/HTTP/writeback/watcher/store callers use that facade. The pure task-create serializer remains available.

(己, p=1) Native Map/Set graph traversal now enters the existing cycle guard explicitly. The valid `!!omap` self-cycle is refused before conversion and targeted updates, while shared acyclic aliases remain readable and editable. Scalar title tests assert one correlated event per edit, the decoded old title, raw requested new value, and the written write-id.

# Evidence

(己, p=1) Final actual `pnpm test`: 181 tests, 1,075 assertions, zero failures/errors, zero compiler warnings. Compile autorun and standalone Node execution both pass. Final actual `pnpm build`: `server`, `cli`, `github-sync`, `app` all pass with zero compiler warnings. Final actual normal `pnpm lint`: zero errors/warnings, eight preexisting informational findings. Their type/file/row/column/message exactly match the original baseline; only the new shape-to-extern dependency finding is removed. Final logs use the `-pure-admission.log` suffix.

(己, p=1) Architectural red uses the shipped layer-boundary hook: original lint emits the specific shape-to-extern info and an external architectural assertion fails, exit 1. The same assertion passes on the split; an additional complete lint-summary assertion checks zero errors/warnings and eight infos. No lint rules or hook/configuration files changed.

(己, p=1) Cycle fixtures alone fail before the guard change: NBB 2 tests/15 assertions, three failures; compiled full content-parser namespace 28 tests/158 assertions, three failures. Both pass after the guard change. After the boundary split, the two exact fixture forms also pass in an external NBB scaffold using the migrated facade: 2 tests/15 assertions. The full compiled suite includes both fixtures. The whole parser test namespace has a preexisting NBB analysis limitation at `cljs.core/ExceptionInfo`; its diagnostic remains preserved rather than counted as a full NBB pass.

(己, p=1) JVM Clojure directly loads both new `.cljc` namespaces and passes external BOM/CRLF/body-preservation, raw-event-value, title-shape and non-finite-value assertions. A later peer found that direct callers of the new public pure plan could bypass admission: namespaced/numeric keys and duplicate aliases produced incorrect/conflicting changes even though runtime infra was safe. The initial qualification and reviews missed that distinct obligation. `pure-entrypoint/` preserves the unfixed four-argument plan, portable tests and actual JVM/NBB red logs: each 2 tests/7 assertions, three failures, zero errors. After minimal reuse of `checked-updates`, both runtimes pass 2/7; the full compiled suite also includes these tests. Valid custom vector/false values, supplied frontmatter/raw and event order are preserved. Two focused source reviews concur on the shared-admission repair; those reviews did not execute tests.

(己, p=1) `candidate-validation.json` binds the source/test bytes and logs. `candidate-vs-3bc.patch` is the complete candidate. `cycle-focused/red-tests-only.patch` preserves the focused red change; `green-after-cycle-red.patch` applies after it. Red then green application was checked with an external alternate Git index. Canonical and candidate working indexes were unchanged; no commit was created.

# Frames

(己, p=.97) The source split changes internal interfaces deliberately: pure functions consume already decoded data, encoded replacements and range maps; the runtime adapter supplies these coherently from the same raw source. Existing runtime callers preserve their public behavior.

(己, p=.95) The 20 paths are two namespace moves, two new adapters, corresponding imports/documentation, the minimal native guard and focused regression/event assertions, including portable direct-call tests. This remains the approved bounded repair; no new product workflow or document provider is implemented.

# Countermoves

(己, p=1) Runtime uses the declared shadow-cljs 3.4.10 and YAML 2.9.1 through isolated dependencies. Existing pinned source bootstrap completed. Public npm commands use explicitly blank `NPM_TOKEN`; no credentials are required or exposed. The optional missing `source-map-support` notice remains visible in the test log.

(己, p=1) The first cached post-move lint reported eight stale arity/private-call diagnostics from old `.cljs` analysis. Cache-disabled analysis was clean. The isolated generated cache was preserved externally, and ordinary `pnpm lint` then passed. This refresh did not suppress findings.

(己, p=1) `historical-initial-split/` retains the earlier report, hashes and complete patch. Direct pure-boundary red is bound to the initial uncommitted four-argument split API, not the original three-argument source at 3bc. The separate cycle red remains bound to 3bc and applies before the complete green patch.

(己, p=1) Local qualification and independent review do not supply a native PR approval or current-head merge admission. Parent owns provenance persistence, ordinary red/green commits, fresh exact-head reviews and settlement.

# Next

(己, p=1) Parent inspect and transplant the preserved red patch followed by the qualified green patch.

      frame (content/frontmatter-source raw)
      patched (content/patch-frontmatter-source
               raw [["title" "\"new\""]]
               [{:key "title" :key-end 5 :start 7 :end 10}])
      plan (edit/plan-frontmatter-update {:title "old"}
                                         {:title "false"} patched {"title" false})]
  (assert (= "\r\nBody  \r\n" (:body frame)))
  (assert (= (str "\uFEFF---\r\ntitle: \"new\"\r\nmetadata: {keep: true}\r\n---\r\n\r\nBody  \r\n") patched))
  (assert (= [{:key "title" :old-value "old" :new-value false}] (:changes plan)))
  (assert (= {:title "false"} (:frontmatter plan)))
  (assert (= [["priority" 7] ["labels" ["a" false nil]]]
             (content/checked-updates (array-map :priority 7 :labels ["a" false nil]))))

                 (catch clojure.lang.ExceptionInfo _ true))))

(ns cycle-focused-proof
  (:require [cljs.test :as t :refer [deftest is testing]]
            [clojure.string :as str]
            ["yaml" :as yaml]
            [rheos.backend.infra.content-parser :as parser]))
(deftest ordered-map-cyclic-aliases-refuse-reads-and-updates
  (let [source "status: incoming\nmetadata: !!omap &self\n  - self: *self\n"
        raw (str "---\n" source "---\nBody  \n")
        ^js document (yaml/parseDocument source #js {:stringKeys true :schema "core"})
        ^js native (.toJS document #js {:maxAliasCount 100})
        ^js metadata (.-metadata native)]
    (testing "the accepted standard tag resolves to an actual native Map cycle"
      (is (empty? (seq (.-errors document))))
      (is (instance? js/Map metadata))
      (is (identical? metadata (.get metadata "self"))))
    (testing "reads and low-level updates refuse that cycle with its declared type"
      (doseq [operation [#(parser/parse-frontmatter raw)
                         #(parser/parse-task-content raw)
                         #(parser/update-frontmatter raw "status" "done")]]
        (let [error (try (operation) nil (catch :default e e))]
          (is (= :cyclic-alias (:type (ex-data error)))))))))

(deftest ordered-map-shared-aliases-remain-readable-and-editable
  (let [source "status: incoming\nmetadata: !!omap &shared\n  - a: &values [one, two]\n  - b: *values\ncopy: *shared\n"
        raw (str "---\n" source "---\nBody  \n")
        ^js document (yaml/parseDocument source #js {:stringKeys true :schema "core"})
        ^js native (.toJS document #js {:maxAliasCount 100})
        ^js metadata (.-metadata native)
        expected {:a ["one" "two"] :b ["one" "two"]}
        parsed (parser/parse-frontmatter raw)
        updated (parser/update-frontmatter raw "status" "done")
        reparsed (parser/parse-frontmatter updated)]
    (testing "the acyclic fixture shares both a native Map and its nested values"
      (is (empty? (seq (.-errors document))))
      (is (instance? js/Map metadata))
      (is (identical? metadata (.-copy native)))
      (is (identical? (.get metadata "a") (.get metadata "b"))))
    (testing "shared values remain Clojure-shaped before and after a targeted edit"
      (is (= expected (get-in parsed [:frontmatter :metadata])
             (get-in parsed [:frontmatter :copy])))
      (is (= (str/replace raw "status: incoming" "status: \"done\"") updated))
      (is (= "done" (get-in reparsed [:frontmatter :status])))
      (is (= expected (get-in reparsed [:frontmatter :metadata])
             (get-in reparsed [:frontmatter :copy])))
      (is (= "Body  \n" (:content parsed) (:content reparsed))))))

(defmethod t/report [::t/default :end-run-tests] [summary]
  (when-not (t/successful? summary) (set! (.-exitCode js/process) 1)))
(t/run-tests 'cycle-focused-proof)

(ns rheos.backend.domain.task-edit
  "Plan non-status task edits from already decoded source data.
   Infra owns YAML validation, write-id stamping, file writes and event emission."
  (:require [rheos.backend.law.frontmatter :as law-frontmatter]
            [rheos.backend.shape.content-parser :as content-parser]))

(defn plan-frontmatter-update
  "Judge decoded replacement frontmatter and preserve the requested event values.
   Returns the supplied rendered raw content, qualified frontmatter, and changes
   in the order updates iterates. Encoding and decoding belong to the adapter."
  [old-frontmatter new-frontmatter new-raw updates]
  {:raw new-raw
   :frontmatter (law-frontmatter/assert-title-shape new-frontmatter)
   :changes (mapv (fn [[k v]]
                    (let [key-str (if (keyword? k) (name k) (str k))]
                      {:key key-str
                       :old-value (get old-frontmatter (keyword key-str))
                       :new-value v}))
                  updates)})

(defn plan-comment
  "Render the proposed comment from already decoded task data; infra stamps it."
  [raw parsed text]
  (content-parser/append-comment raw parsed text))

+    (testing (str "refuses " updates " before returning a change plan")
+      (let [error (try

+                      {:title "old"} {:title "new"} "rendered source" updates)
+                    nil

+        (is (= message (when error (ex-message error))))))))

+(deftest frontmatter-plan-preserves-admitted-extension-events

+        updates (array-map :custom value "title" false)

+        raw "rendered source\n"
+        plan (task-edit/plan-frontmatter-update
+               {:title "old" :custom "prior"} frontmatter raw updates)]
+    (is (identical? frontmatter (:frontmatter plan)))
+    (is (= raw (:raw plan)))
+    (is (= [{:key "custom" :old-value "prior" :new-value value}
+            {:key "title" :old-value "old" :new-value false}]
+           (:changes plan)))
+    (is (identical? value (:new-value (first (:changes plan)))))))

(ns rheos.backend.domain.task-edit
  "Plan non-status task edits from already decoded source data.
   Infra owns YAML validation, write-id stamping, file writes and event emission."
  (:require [rheos.backend.law.frontmatter :as law-frontmatter]
            [rheos.backend.shape.content-parser :as content-parser]))

(defn plan-frontmatter-update
  "Judge decoded replacement frontmatter and preserve the requested event values.
   Returns the supplied rendered raw content, qualified frontmatter, and changes
   in the order updates iterates. Encoding and decoding belong to the adapter."
  [old-frontmatter new-frontmatter new-raw updates]
  {:raw new-raw
   :frontmatter (law-frontmatter/assert-title-shape new-frontmatter)
   :changes (mapv (fn [[k v]]
                    (let [key-str (if (keyword? k) (name k) (str k))]
                      {:key key-str
                       :old-value (get old-frontmatter (keyword key-str))
                       :new-value v}))
                  updates)})

(defn plan-comment
  "Render the proposed comment from already decoded task data; infra stamps it."
  [raw parsed text]
  (content-parser/append-comment raw parsed text))
